keyBusinessRules.BR-001: Validate coord_x IN [0, warehouse.layout_width_m] in SaveWarehouseLayout command for each location
keyBusinessRules.BR-002: Validate zone rect (layout_x + layout_width) <= warehouse.layout_width_m; same for Y
keyBusinessRules.BR-003: Warn (not block) if location coord falls outside parent zone rect
keyBusinessRules.BR-005: locations WHERE coord_x IS NULL are unplaced — exclude from canvas rendering response
keyBusinessRules.BR-006: All new columns NULL-able — zero impact on existing operations
keyBusinessRules.BR-009: Validate layout_width_m IS NOT NULL AND layout_height_m IS NOT NULL before accepting zone placement in SaveWarehouseLayout

inventoryMapQuery.description: SQL pattern for GetWarehouseInventoryMap — join location with invent_on_hand
inventoryMapQuery.sql: SELECT l.id, l.code, l.coord_x, l.coord_y, l.width_m, l.depth_m, l.capacity_mt, l.rotation_deg, COALESCE(SUM(oh.qty_mt),0) AS current_qty_mt, COALESCE(SUM(oh.qty_mt)/NULLIF(l.capacity_mt,0)*100,0) AS occupancy_pct, z.layout_color AS zone_color FROM cat.location l LEFT JOIN invent.invent_on_hand oh ON oh.location_id = l.id AND oh.tenant_id = l.tenant_id JOIN cat.zone z ON z.id = l.zone_id WHERE l.warehouse_id = @WarehouseId AND l.coord_x IS NOT NULL AND l.tenant_id = @TenantId GROUP BY l.id, l.code, l.coord_x, l.coord_y, l.width_m, l.depth_m, l.capacity_mt, l.rotation_deg, z.layout_color
inventoryMapQuery.filterNote: Optional filter by owner_id / item_id — add OH joins for those when filter present

featureSchema.description: Zod schemas for warehouse layout types
featureSchema.code:
import { z } from 'zod'

export const zoneLayoutSchema = z.object({
  id: z.string().uuid(),
  code: z.string(),
  name: z.string(),
  zoneType: z.string(),
  layoutX: z.number().nullable(),
  layoutY: z.number().nullable(),
  layoutWidth: z.number().nullable(),
  layoutHeight: z.number().nullable(),
  layoutColor: z.string().nullable().default('#4A90D9'),
  isPlaced: z.boolean(),
})

export const locationLayoutSchema = z.object({
  id: z.string().uuid(),
  code: z.string(),
  name: z.string(),
  locationType: z.string(),
  zoneId: z.string().uuid().nullable(),
  coordX: z.number().nullable(),
  coordY: z.number().nullable(),
  coordZ: z.number().nullable(),
  widthM: z.number().nullable(),
  depthM: z.number().nullable(),
  heightM: z.number().nullable(),
  rotationDeg: z.number().nullable().default(0),
  aisle: z.string().nullable(),
  rackNo: z.string().nullable(),
  shelfLevel: z.number().nullable(),
  binCol: z.number().nullable(),
  isPlaced: z.boolean(),
})

export const warehouseLayoutSchema = z.object({
  warehouseId: z.string().uuid(),
  warehouseName: z.string(),
  layoutWidthM: z.number().nullable(),
  layoutHeightM: z.number().nullable(),
  floorPlanUrl: z.string().nullable(),
  zones: z.array(zoneLayoutSchema),
  locations: z.array(locationLayoutSchema),
})

export const locationOccupancySchema = z.object({
  locationId: z.string().uuid(),
  locationCode: z.string(),
  coordX: z.number(),
  coordY: z.number(),
  widthM: z.number().nullable(),
  depthM: z.number().nullable(),
  rotationDeg: z.number(),
  capacityMt: z.number().nullable(),
  currentQtyMt: z.number(),
  occupancyPct: z.number().nullable(),
  zoneColor: z.string(),
  topItems: z.array(z.object({
    ownerName: z.string(),
    itemName: z.string(),
    qtyMt: z.number(),
  })).optional(),
})

export type ZoneLayoutDto = z.infer<typeof zoneLayoutSchema>
export type LocationLayoutDto = z.infer<typeof locationLayoutSchema>
export type WarehouseLayoutDto = z.infer<typeof warehouseLayoutSchema>
export type LocationOccupancyDto = z.infer<typeof locationOccupancySchema>

export interface SaveLayoutCommand {
  layoutWidthM?: number | null
  layoutHeightM?: number | null
  zones: Array<{ id: string; layoutX?: number | null; layoutY?: number | null; layoutWidth?: number | null; layoutHeight?: number | null; layoutColor?: string | null }>
  locations: Array<{ id: string; coordX?: number | null; coordY?: number | null; coordZ?: number | null; widthM?: number | null; depthM?: number | null; heightM?: number | null; rotationDeg?: number | null; aisle?: string | null; rackNo?: string | null; shelfLevel?: number | null; binCol?: number | null }>
}
